name: i18n-language-standards
description: Enforce ASD-STE100 (English) and clear Korean UI language standards across LibrAgent. Audits UI text, Settings descriptions, and i18n locales for prohibited engineering jargon, internal code identifiers (browser="userChrome", awaitAgent, pollProcess, createSession), passive translations, and ensures terminology parity across all 8 supported languages. Triggers on: "언어 규약", "language standards", "i18n standards", "ASD-STE100", "i18n audit", "i18n 검증", "언어 규약 검사", "layman-friendly UI text", "i18n-language-standards".
